dependencies.name: @opencode-ai/sdk
dependencies.purpose: Submit prompts to the attached CodeArts session through the native OpenCode-compatible session API while preserving the original TUI VT evidence stream.
dependencies.officialGap: Windows ConPTY input injection cannot submit CodeArts prompts after the TUI enables Win32 input mode while VT capture remains active.

dependencies.name: @xterm/headless
dependencies.purpose: Parse the original CodeArts ConPTY VT stream without creating another terminal session.
dependencies.officialGap: OpenCode events do not expose the rendered terminal screen required by the external acceptance harness.

dependencies.name: @xterm/xterm
dependencies.purpose: Render the same ConPTY VT stream in an independent visible observer window.
dependencies.officialGap: CodeArts provides the tested TUI but not an independent observer surface for unattended evidence capture.

dependencies.name: bun-pty
dependencies.purpose: Drive the installed CodeArts TUI through Windows ConPTY from the Bun runtime.
dependencies.officialGap: OpenCode SDK and CodeArts do not provide a deterministic API for real interactive TUI keyboard and resize behavior; bun-pty kill emits its exit event before Windows descendant processes are guaranteed to have terminated, so the Harness must await OS process-tree shutdown.

dependencies.name: playwright-core
dependencies.purpose: Automate the original OpenChamber GUI with an installed browser.
dependencies.officialGap: OpenCode SDK has no browser automation or browser diagnostics API.
